game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · History/classification review
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool, a blue oasis pool: the caravan guide must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool: a blue oasis pool
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 1: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about History/classification review.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Oasis Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.

source_player_objective: Protect the temple door from giant scorpions in Oasis Pool: keep the autopsy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: autopsy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Oasis Pool Defense
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
